'''Keturah's Point''' was located at the top of [[Orane Mountain]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]]. It got its name from [[Keturah Ambar]], who trekked to the look-out point every day after her husband, [[Drexler Ambar]], disappeared without a trace. For ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]], Keturah went to the top of the mountain to watch for any sign of her husband's return.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
